name: Prince's Choice
source:
Emory is an 18 year old boy who lives a comfortable life as the son of a wealthy business owner- he has servants waiting on him, private tutors that come to his house, a personal maid, and is even friends with the prince of the kingdom. Up until now, all of his choices were made in advance by others, like what he would do for the day and what his tutors would teach him. However, as he's recently turned 18, things are starting to change at not only his home but also the kingdom's castle...

[From [url=http://mikomikisomi.itch.io/princes-choice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃默里是一名18岁的男孩，作为富有企业家的儿子，他过着舒适的生活：有仆人随时侍候，有私人教师上门授课，有专属女仆，甚至还和王国的王子是朋友。一直以来，他每天要做什么、教师要教什么，都由别人提前替他决定。然而，最近刚满18岁的他发现，自己的家乃至王国城堡都开始发生变化……
